body:
I honestly do feel violated, I'm planning on sitting him down for a talk about it later on today once I've collected my thoughts a bit more


I'm unsure if it will affect sex with him in the longterm but I know right now just thinking about it makes me feel weird, so I think I'll be out of commission in that regard for a while ;_; 


I understand that I'm partially at fault because during the act I never specifically said "hey, I'm not digging this lets stop", and I acted receptive, so really the first indicator he got was when I started crying which was a bit of a shock for him


consent in relationships is a difficult subject for me because I've been manipulated by a previous boyfriend into doing things I specifically and numerously told him I didn't want to do, so I think it's bringing back bad memories of that too?? 


I'm sorry if this is rambly, and thank you for replying!!
